morphology.pattern_note: 输入的小写检索形式保留为 amahl；作为人名使用时写作 Amahl。没有可据以分析的马来语词缀，不应自动改写为 amal。is_root 仅沿用输入中的未派生标记。

senses.zh_definition: 专名 Amahl 的小写检索形式；一个有明确文献依据的所指是梅诺蒂歌剧《Amahl and the Night Visitors》中的男孩阿马尔。输入不足以确定原始语料是否指该人物。
senses.en_definition: The lowercase lookup form of the proper name Amahl, borne, for example, by the boy in Menotti's opera Amahl and the Night Visitors.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian editorial, bukan takrif rasmi DBP: nama khas Amahl, antaranya nama watak budak lelaki dalam opera Amahl and the Night Visitors karya Gian Carlo Menotti; rujukan sebenar dalam data asal belum dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 不能当作已获 DBP 认证的普通马来语词。以下搭配和例句明确采用歌剧人物这一有据可查的所指，不代表已确定输入语料的所指。搭配为教学示例，不宣称具有高频统计依据。[拉脱维亚国家歌剧院作品介绍](https://www.opera.lv/en/production/amahl-and-the-night-visitors/)

dual_scenarios.context: 文化报道 / 歌剧介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Amahl ialah watak budak lelaki dalam opera satu babak Amahl and the Night Visitors karya Gian Carlo Menotti.
dual_scenarios.zh: 阿马尔是吉安·卡洛·梅诺蒂的独幕歌剧《Amahl and the Night Visitors》中的男孩角色。
dual_scenarios.en: Amahl is the boy in Gian Carlo Menotti's one-act opera Amahl and the Night Visitors.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok budak yang bawa watak Amahl tu?

dual_scenarios.zh: 你看过演阿马尔的那个孩子了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you seen the kid playing Amahl?

etymology.historical_story: Amahl has a documented cultural association with Gian Carlo Menotti's one-act opera Amahl and the Night Visitors, first performed by NBC Opera Theatre on 24 December 1951. The title character is a boy living with his mother. This history identifies a verifiable use of the name; it does not establish the name's linguistic origin or the intended referent in the supplied data.
